metadata.question: Was snow present near the Mississippi River Delta Basin (Plaquemines-Balize Delta) during the interval of January 21-24, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Geometry: A rectangle covering the Plaquemines–Balize Delta near the Mississippi River Delta in Louisiana, USA.
- Date: 2025-01-21 to 2025-01-25 (covers Jan 21–24 inclusive).
- Primary collection: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED). Fallback: Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 SR.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds and cloud shadows but retain potential snow.
- Sentinel-2: Use SCL to mask 0,1,3,8,9,10; keep 11 (snow).
- Landsat: QA_PIXEL to mask dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow; do NOT mask snow bit.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size is 0 → try fallback; if still 0 → C1.
- If valid pixel area/count after masking == 0 → C2.
- If reduceRegion returns null/NaN → C3.
- Otherwise, compute NDSI-based snow, and decide Yes/No. Threshold: NDSI > 0.42 and GREEN > 0.1; snow present if snow area ≥ 5 ha.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [-89.95, 29.0],
      [-89.95, 29.6],
      [-89.05, 29.6],
      [-89.05, 29.0],
      [-89.95, 29.0]
    ], null, false);

    const start = '2025-01-21';
    const end = '2025-01-25'; // exclusive

    // Helper: reduce with named args at safe scale
    const REDUCE_SCALE = 1000;
    const MAX_PIXELS = 1e9;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Preparation
    function maskS2(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const mask = scl.neq(0).and(scl.neq(1)) // no data/defective
        .and(scl.neq(3)) // cloud shadow
        .and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); // clouds
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function addNdsiS2(img) {
      const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI');
      const green = img.select('B3').rename('GREEN');
      return img.addBands([ndsi, green]);
    }

    function applyLsScale(img) {
      const optical = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const thermal = img.select('ST_B.*').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0);
      return img.addBands(optical, null, true).addBands(thermal, null, true);
    }
    function maskLs(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
      const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
      // Do NOT mask snow bit (bit 5) to allow snow detection
      const mask = dilated.not().and(cirrus.not()).and(cloud.not()).and(shadow.not());
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function addNdsiLs(img) {
      const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI');
      const green = img.select('SR_B3').rename('GREEN');
      return img.addBands([ndsi, green]);
    }

    // Primary: Sentinel-2
    let source = null;
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(start, end);
    let colSize = col.size().getInfo();
    if (colSize === 0) {
      // Fallback: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 L2 SR
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
      col = l8.merge(l9);
      colSize = col.size().getInfo();
      if (colSize === 0) {
        console.log(`S2 images: 0`);
        console.log(`Landsat images: 0`);
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location)');
        return;
      } else {
        source = 'Landsat';
        console.log(`S2 images: 0`);
        console.log(`Landsat images: ${colSize}`);
      }
    } else {
      source = 'S2';
      console.log(`S2 images: ${colSize}`);
    }

    // 3. Processing
    let processedCol;
    if (source === 'S2') {
      processedCol = col.map(maskS2).map(addNdsiS2);
    } else {
      processedCol = col.map(applyLsScale).map(maskLs).map(addNdsiLs);
    }

    // Build a composite using the highest NDSI (to capture any snow if present)
    const composite = processedCol.qualityMosaic('NDSI').clip(geom);
    const ndsi = composite.select('NDSI');
    const green = composite.select('GREEN');

    // Valid mask (after cloud/shadow masking)
    const validMask = ndsi.mask();

    // Snow detection mask: NDSI > 0.42 and GREEN > 0.1
    const snowMask = ndsi.gt(0.42).and(green.gt(0.1));

    // 4. Metrics and Validation
    // Total area
    const totalAreaHa = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000).rename('area')
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: REDUCE_SCALE,
        maxPixels: MAX_PIXELS
      }).get('area');

    // Valid area (where we have non-cloudy pixels)
    const validAreaHa = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000).rename('area')
      .updateMask(validMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: REDUCE_SCALE,
        maxPixels: MAX_PIXELS
      }).get('area');

    // Snow area
    const snowAreaHa = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000).rename('area')
      .updateMask(snowMask)
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: REDUCE_SCALE,
        maxPixels: MAX_PIXELS
      }).get('area');

    // Pixel counts at coarse scale for quick validation
    const totalPx = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('const')
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: REDUCE_SCALE,
        maxPixels: MAX_PIXELS
      }).get('const');

    const validPx = ndsi.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: REDUCE_SCALE,
      maxPixels: MAX_PIXELS
    }).get('NDSI');

    const snowPx = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(snowMask).rename('snow')
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: REDUCE_SCALE,
        maxPixels: MAX_PIXELS
      }).get('snow');

    // Bring results to client
    const totalAreaHa_v = totalAreaHa && ee.Number(totalAreaHa).getInfo();
    const validAreaHa_v = validAreaHa && ee.Number(validAreaHa).getInfo();
    const snowAreaHa_v = snowAreaHa && ee.Number(snowAreaHa).getInfo();
    const totalPx_v = totalPx && ee.Number(totalPx).getInfo();
    const validPx_v = validPx && ee.Number(validPx).getInfo();
    const snowPx_v = snowPx && ee.Number(snowPx).getInfo();

    // Handle invalid results
    if (totalAreaHa_v === null || isNaN(totalAreaHa_v)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Total area null)');
      return;
    }
    if (!validAreaHa_v || validAreaHa_v <= 0 || !validPx_v || validPx_v <= 0) {
      // images existed but nothing valid after masking
      console.log(`Valid px (1km): ${validPx_v || 0} / ${totalPx_v || 'NA'}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (All pixels masked by clouds/shadows or no clear coverage)');
      return;
    }
    if (snowAreaHa_v === null || isNaN(snowAreaHa_v)) {
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Snow area null)');
      return;
    }

    const cloudInvalidPct = Math.max(0, (1 - (validAreaHa_v / totalAreaHa_v)) * 100);
    const snowFracPct = (snowAreaHa_v / validAreaHa_v) * 100;

    // 5. Evidence prints (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Total px (1km): ${totalPx_v}`);
    console.log(`Valid px (1km): ${validPx_v}`);
    console.log(`Cloud/Invalid %: ${cloudInvalidPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Snow px (1km): ${snowPx_v}`);
    console.log(`Snow area (ha): ${snowAreaHa_v.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Snow fraction of valid area (%): ${snowFracPct.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`NDSI>0.42 & GREEN>0.1, Source: ${source}`);

    // 6. Decision
    const snowPresent = snowAreaHa_v >= 5; // ≥5 ha indicates snow presence
    if (snowPresent) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected error
    console.log('D: Processing/Script Error');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
